title: Does Learning Recurrent Networks Matter in Partially Observable RL?
abstract: arXiv:2610.13197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) under partial observability typically re- lies on recurrent networks to encode temporal information, with the recurrent module trained jointly with the policy or value function. This raises a natural question: is learning the recurrent network actually necessary? In this paper, we investigate whether a frozen recurrent network can provide sufficient memory for solving par- tially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). Motivated by the theoretical foundations of Reservoir Computing (RC) and Generalized Reservoir Computing (GRC), we study a simple archi- tecture that combines a fixed recurrent network with a trainable nonlinear output module. We evaluate this approach across tasks with varying memory demands, observation modalities, and action spaces. translated_title: 在部分可观测强化学习中，学习循环网络真的重要吗？
translated_abstract: 部分可观测条件下的强化学习（RL）通常依赖循环网络来编码时间信息，循环模块往往与策略或价值函数联合训练。这引出了一个自然的问题：学习循环网络真的有必要吗？在本文中，我们研究了冻结的循环网络能否为求解部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）提供足够的记忆能力。受储备池计算和广义储备池计算理论基础的启发，我们研究了一种将固定循环网络与可训练的非线性输出模块相结合的简单架构。我们在具有不同记忆需求、观测模态和动作空间的各种任务上对该方法进行了评估。令人惊讶的是，冻结的循环网络能够支持数百步的记忆回溯，并在多样化的POMDP任务中取得具有竞争力的控制性能……
tldr: 该研究发现冻结（无需训练）的循环网络即可为部分可观测强化学习提供数百步的记忆能力，并在多样化的POMDP任务中取得与训练循环网络相当的性能，从而质疑了在部分可观测RL中学习循环网络的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that frozen recurrent networks can support memory recall over hundreds of steps and achieve competitive control performance across diverse POMDPs, questioning whether learning the recurrent network is actually necessary in partially observable RL.
